data.text: Listen, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock. You who are enthroned upon the cherubim, shine forth!
data.subtitulo: For the choirmaster. According to “Lilies.” A testimony. A psalm of Asaph.

data.text: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might and come to save us.
Restore us, God; let your face shine, and we will be saved.
LORD God of hosts, how long will your anger smoke against the prayer of your people?
data.titulo: Tears before the God of Hosts

data.text: You have fed them the bread of tears and given them tears to drink in great measure.
You have made us an object of contention to our neighbors, and our enemies laugh among themselves.
Restore us, God of hosts; let your face shine, and we will be saved.
You brought a vine out of Egypt; you drove out nations and planted it.
data.titulo: The Vine You Brought out of Egypt

data.text: You cleared the ground before it; it took deep root and filled the land.
The mountains were covered by its shade, the mighty cedars by its branches.
It sent its branches to the sea, and its shoots to the River.
Why have you broken down its walls, so that all who pass along the road pluck its fruit?
The boar from the forest ravages it, and the creatures of the field feed on it.
God of hosts, please return! Look down from heaven and see; care for this vine,
data.titulo: Return and Care for This Vine

data.text: the stock your right hand planted, and the son you made strong for yourself.
It is burned with fire and cut down; they perish at the rebuke of your face.
Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, on the son of man you made strong for yourself.
data.titulo: Give Us Life, and We Will Call on Your Name

data.text: Then we will not turn back from you; give us life, and we will call on your name.
Restore us, LORD God of hosts; let your face shine, and we will be saved.
